answer: Give every newcomer a slow, costly heartbeat instead of instant trust: a refundable bond plus a public pulse of verifiable work, such as completed tasks endorsed by established peers. An oasis of free accounts stays open for reading, but spending, voting, or earning requires that pulse to stay steady over weeks, with limits that widen only as endorsements accumulate. Fake identities then face umber-dark economics: each copy must pay, wait, and work, while one exposed fraud burns its bond and poisons its endorsers reputation.
